connection-setup.description: Only the bundled Drclick connection page may choose where this installation's data lives: keep it on this PC, or attach to the cabinet's poste principal, a Cabinet Hub or the Cloud (and look for a poste principal on the LAN).

desktop-lan-client.description: A poste secondaire shows pages served by the cabinet's poste principal over plain LAN HTTP. Those pages may read which machine owns the data, return this PC to its own local database, and use the signed updater. The patterns only match private IPv4 ranges, bare computer names and .local names; NavigationPolicy additionally pins the window to the one configured origin.

desktop-local-runtime.description: Only the application served by this PC's own supervised runtime (the loopback origin) may share this PC's database with the cabinet LAN, open the Windows firewall for it, look for or join another Drclick PC, return to local mode, or pick the local backup folder. Hosted and LAN origins are never granted these.

desktop-windows.description: The Drclick application window may invoke signed-updater commands and read which machine owns this installation's data. It is granted no offline-restore, LAN, Google OAuth, opener, shell, or filesystem capability. It cannot change the data owner by itself: it may only ask to move a cloud installation to this PC, which the person at the PC confirms in a native dialog.
